integrity.proven_vs_unproven: Theorem proved for every integer degree at least two, real searcher rate positive and trap rate nonnegative. No claims for other initial distributions, graphs, or meeting-time tails.
integrity.statement_scope: Exact all-degree, all-positive-searcher-rate rational formulas and sharp delay comparisons, with finite test corroboration

scientific_limitations: Fixed leaf–hub start, a finite undirected star with at least two leaves, independent continuous-time walkers, edge-clock or vertex-clock rates; only expected encounter time is classified. General moving-trap delays and comb anomalies are established prior work. Independent literature and proof audit remain outstanding.
title: Two mobility conventions give sharply different capture slowdowns on stars
